## Source rows matching a target row
# UPDATE and MERGE fail when a target row matches more than one source row, and change nothing;
# target rows that match the same source row, unmatched duplicates and matches no action applies
# to are valid, as is a MERGE that only deletes.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/dml-syntax#update_statement

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT id, 0 AS v FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 2, 3]) AS id;
UPDATE t SET v = s.v FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS id, 10 AS v), (1, 20), (3, 30)]) AS s
WHERE t.id = s.id
=> error contains: must match at most one source row

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT id, 0 AS v FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 2, 3]) AS id;
MERGE t USING UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS id, 10 AS v), (1, 20), (4, 40)]) AS s ON t.id = s.id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v = s.v
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, v) VALUES (s.id, s.v)
=> error contains: must match at most one source row

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT id, 0 AS v FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 2, 3]) AS id;
BEGIN
  UPDATE t SET v = s.v FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS id, 10 AS v), (1, 20), (3, 30)]) AS s
  WHERE t.id = s.id;
EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
  SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT id, v FROM t ORDER BY id));
END
=> "[{\"id\":1,\"v\":0},{\"id\":2,\"v\":0},{\"id\":2,\"v\":0},{\"id\":3,\"v\":0}]"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT id, 0 AS v FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 2, 3]) AS id;
UPDATE t SET v = s.v FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(2 AS id, 22 AS v), (9, 90), (9, 99)]) AS s
WHERE t.id = s.id;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT id, v FROM t ORDER BY id))
=> "[{\"id\":1,\"v\":0},{\"id\":2,\"v\":22},{\"id\":2,\"v\":22},{\"id\":3,\"v\":0}]"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT id, 0 AS v FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 2, 3]) AS id;
MERGE t USING (SELECT id FROM UNNEST([5, 5]) AS id) AS s ON t.id = s.id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v = 50
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, v) VALUES (s.id, 50);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT id, v FROM t WHERE id = 5))
=> "[{\"id\":5,\"v\":50},{\"id\":5,\"v\":50}]"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT id, 0 AS v FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 2, 3]) AS id;
MERGE t USING (SELECT id FROM UNNEST([1, 1]) AS id) AS s ON t.id = s.id
WHEN MATCHED AND t.v = 99 THEN UPDATE SET v = 100;
SELECT COUNTIF(v = 100) FROM t
=> "0"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT id, 0 AS v FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 2, 3]) AS id;
MERGE t USING (SELECT id FROM UNNEST([1, 1]) AS id) AS s ON t.id = s.id
WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY id))
=> "[2,2,3]"
